description: This is a Java test class for the ScrollViewWithDisable component, testing touch event handling when enabled or disabled.

classes.name: ScrollViewWithDisableTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ScrollViewWithDisable, testing touch event behavior when enabled or disabled.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a ScrollViewWithDisable instance and adding a View.

methods.name: testOnTouchEventEnabled
methods.description: Tests that onTouchEvent returns true when the view is enabled and a touch event occurs.

methods.name: testOnTouchEventDisabled
methods.description: Tests that onTouchEvent returns false when the view is disabled and a touch event occurs.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEventDisabled
methods.description: Tests that onInterceptTouchEvent returns false when the view is disabled and a touch event occurs.
